usedFor: 42min is the scheduler people book through; HubSpot is where deals are tracked. A “New Booking” in 42min can run “Create Deal” so every booked meeting starts as a deal.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in 42min, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A booking is the moment someone commits time, and you can limit it to one event type so only sales calls become deals.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the deal ID, so use “Updated Booking Time” with a deal that already exists. Using “Create Deal” on a reschedule would add a second deal.
